title: OverturoDecision
description: Canonical Overturo decision shape. Shared across overturo-authorize-{py,js} and overturo-oversight-{py,js} SDKs. Wire response body conforms additively (existing fields like iss/oap_ver are preserved).

mode.description: Server-resolved application mode at decision time.

reason_code.description: Closed enum from Oap::Errors::REASON_CODES; set on deny.

cascade_step.description: Position at which the cascade decided (set on deny).

block_invocations.description: Per-position cascade evaluations in ascending position order. Empty when decomposition was not opted in.

receipt.description: On allow: server returns the JWT as a String at the existing 'receipt' field; SDKs MAY wrap it into an object alongside receipt_jti/iat/exp. Schema accepts both shapes for backward compatibility.

decision_latency_ms.description: Server-measured controller-entry-to-render wall clock. Null on deny path (latency unmeasured).

request_id.description: Rails request.request_id echo. Also returned in X-Request-Id response header.
